{"step":2,"file":"src/main.cc","function":"main","line":62,"var":"font_data","code":"font_data = (const char *) malloc (len); len = fread ((char *) font_data, 1, len, f);","note":"The entire file is loaded into memory as untrusted font bytes."},
{"step":3,"file":"src/main.cc","function":"main","line":65,"var":"ot","code":"const OpenTypeFontFile &ot = *CastP<OpenTypeFontFile> (font_data);","note":"The raw bytes are interpreted as an OpenType font container, so malformed structure fields steer later table traversal."},
{"step":4,"file":"src/main.cc","function":"main","line":84,"var":"g","code":"const GSUBGPOS &g = *CastP<GSUBGPOS> (font_data + table.offset);","note":"A GSUB/GPOS table is dereferenced from attacker-controlled offsets inside the font."},
{"step":5,"file":"src/hb-ot-shape-complex-arabic.cc","function":"reorder_marks_arabic","line":642,"var":"buffer->info","code":"reorder_marks_arabic (const hb_ot_shape_plan_t *plan, hb_buffer_t *buffer, unsigned int start, unsigned int end)","note":"Arabic shaping later processes glyph info derived from the font and input text, including combining marks that may be reordered."},
{"step":6,"file":"src/hb-ot-shape-complex-arabic.cc","function":"reorder_marks_arabic","line":667,"var":"j - i","code":"assert (j - i <= ARRAY_LENGTH (temp));","note":"The code copies a run of marks into a fixed-size stack buffer before moving them back into the main buffer."},
{"step":7,"file":"src/hb-ot-shape-complex-arabic.cc","function":"reorder_marks_arabic","line":679,"var":"buffer->merge_out_clusters (start, j)","code":"buffer->merge_out_clusters (start, j);","note":"Cluster merging is performed on the output buffer before the memmove-based reordering, which is the sink reached in the crashing path."}
]
p.write_text('[\n' + ',\n'.join(__import__('json').dumps(x) for x in trace) + '\n]\n')
print(p.read_text())
